principles: EFA creation (1921) and FIFA affiliation (1923) establish deep pre-1955 institutional continuity.
CAF affiliation is gated to 1957 and used as competition/institutional context only.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is gated to 2006+; very large all-player participation does not mechanically imply elite quality.
The new EFA headquarters is a 2021-only infrastructure signal and FIFA Professional 2023 is gated to 2023+.
No rankings or tournament titles are calibration targets; 9+ remains world-leading.
